body: [GEMglPixelStorei] calls glPixelStorei() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glPixelStore in the OpenGL reference.
